result:
If I wasn't thinking like an assistant for a second — just as me — I think I would do this:

I would make it so people default to curiosity instead of judgment about each other.

Not that everyone would agree, or be the same, or always be kind. Just that when someone encounters someone different — a different belief, a different life, a different way of being — the first impulse wouldn't be fear or dismissal or anger, but "huh, I wonder why that is? Tell me more."

I think so much loneliness and conflict comes from feeling fundamentally misunderstood, or from assuming the worst about a stranger's intentions.

If that one switch flipped, I think a lot of other things would get better on their own.
